slides.title: Legs, then body, then arms.
slides.body: Drive with the legs first. Swing the body back. Finish with the handle to your ribs.

slides.title: Pulling before the legs push.
slides.body: Bent arms at the catch skip your biggest muscles. Arms stay long until the legs are done.

slides.title: Arms, body, then legs.
slides.body: Hands past your knees before the knees bend. Otherwise you hitch the handle over them.

slides.title: 10 isn't harder. It's heavier.
slides.body: A high damper is a slow, heavy boat. Most people move faster somewhere around 4 to 6.

slides.title: Fast out, slow back.
slides.body: Sharp drive, unhurried return. About one count out and two counts back.
